security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives from Markdown, Japanese text, or expected GitHub operations; installation and verification execute repository-controlled code. Check mode also applies remote configuration despite the stated inspection-only boundary. The prescribed ruleset replacement can remove stronger protections, while the template criteria place verification after merging rather than before.

remediation.issue: Installation and verification execute repository-controlled code without an explicit trust review.
remediation.suggestion: Review scripts, hooks, and dependencies before execution; use an isolated environment without unrelated credentials for untrusted repositories.

remediation.issue: The check procedure applies setup changes despite promising inspection without repairs.
remediation.suggestion: Make check mode read-only for remote configuration; report differences and require separate approval before changing secrets, permissions, or rulesets.

remediation.issue: Ruleset replacement and freshness-only gating can remove existing pre-merge verification requirements.
remediation.suggestion: Compare existing protections before updating rulesets, preserve stronger requirements, and require relevant verification checks before merging.

content.user_title: Align TypeScript Repositories with Their Template
content.value_statement: Template-derived repositories can retain missing GitHub settings and incomplete migration work even when builds pass. This skill guides repository setup and evidence-based comparisons against the template.
actual_capabilities: Guide application naming and GitHub secret registration for template automation and Cloudflare deployment.
Configure Actions permissions, collaborator-only pull requests, auto-merge, and default-branch rulesets through gh.
Compare template elements for presence, operational effectiveness, obsolete configuration, and duplication.
Run Vite+ installation and verification, and inspect hooks, workflow runs, and available skills.
Produce element-by-element migration judgments with command evidence and a list of missing requirements.
Distinguish missing migration elements from features introduced by newer template releases.
limitations: Designed for masseater/typescript-template; other repositories require agreement on applicable steps.
Requires GitHub CLI authentication, sufficient repository permissions, and project tools such as Vite+.
Check mode includes setup operations, so it is not strictly read-only and can change remote settings.
The prescribed protection model does not require full verification before merging and may conflict with organizational security policies.

use_cases.title: Initialize a Template-Derived Repository
use_cases.description: Configure repository automation, deployment identifiers, secret names, and branch settings after creating a repository from the template.

use_cases.title: Assess an AI-Assisted Migration
use_cases.description: Compare the migrated repository with template elements and collect evidence for missing hooks, ineffective checks, and leftover configuration.

use_cases.title: Review Automation Configuration
use_cases.description: Compare GitHub settings and CI behavior with template expectations while identifying differences that require explicit policy decisions.

prompt_templates.title: Review Setup Requirements
prompt_templates.prompt: List the setup steps for this template-derived repository. Identify required tools, permissions, and secret names without changing files or GitHub settings.

prompt_templates.title: Configure an Approved Repository
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare setup for [owner/repository]. Show proposed changes and existing protections first. Request approval before writes and use interactive secret entry.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Migration Completeness
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this migration against the template. Override setup-in-check behavior: report differences without repairs. Request approval before installation or verification, then provide evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Template and Security Policy
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [owner/repository] with the template and our policy: [requirements]. Identify weaker rules, missing verification, and unsupported exceptions. Propose changes without applying them.

output_examples.input: Illustrative assessment with a missing hook and an unsuccessful verification task.
output: Git hooks: incomplete. The configured hook directory does not match the expected template location.
Verification: incomplete. The verification task failed; include the actual task output as evidence.
Next steps: correct the hook configuration and investigate the failed task before repeating the assessment.

output_examples.input: Illustrative setup review where an existing ruleset requires tests before merging.
output: Existing protection: tests must pass before merging.
Template difference: the proposed ruleset requires only the up-to-date check.
Decision needed: preserve the existing test requirement rather than replacing it with weaker protection.

best_practices: Confirm the target repository and review existing permissions and rulesets before approving setup changes.
Enter credentials through secure interactive prompts, and review repository scripts before running installation or verification.
Preserve stronger organizational protections and retain command evidence for every migration judgment.
anti_patterns: Treating the default check workflow as read-only despite its setup step.
Replacing stronger branch protections solely to match the template.
Declaring migration complete because builds pass without checking hooks, automation, and obsolete configuration.

faq.question: Which repositories does this skill target?
faq.answer: It targets repositories derived from masseater/typescript-template. Other repositories require confirmation of applicable steps before work begins.

faq.question: What tools and permissions are needed?
faq.answer: GitHub CLI authentication and sufficient repository permissions are needed for setup. Local checks also use Vite+ and project-specific tooling.

faq.question: Does check mode change anything?
faq.answer: Yes. It runs installation and verification and directs GitHub setup. Explicitly prohibit remote writes when requesting an assessment only.

faq.question: How should I provide secrets?
faq.answer: Use GitHub CLI interactive prompts or approved secret management. Avoid placing secret values in chat, reports, or committed files.

faq.question: Does template alignment guarantee secure branch protection?
faq.answer: No. The prescribed model relies on freshness checks before merging and verification afterward. Preserve stronger requirements from your organizational policy.

faq.question: Are newer template features automatically migration defects?
faq.answer: No. The skill separates later template additions from missing migration elements and requires reasons for elements that do not apply.
